0x10277A50.name: SqmdModel_Validate
0x10277A50.evidence: Prints "model is not loaded (validation f..." (0x103B3848) when bit 0 of model+0xA8 is clear and "model is not linked (validation f..." (0x103B381C) when bit 1 is clear, both with sqmdModel.c lines 0x77/0x7D; returns 0xFF in the low byte when both are set.
0x10277A50.summary: Checks that a model is loaded and linked (flags 1 and 2 at +0xA8); prints the error and returns false otherwise.

0x10278490.name: SqmdModel_Update
0x10278490.evidence: After SqmdModel_Validate fails it prints "aborting %s command" with "sqmdModelUpdate" (0x103B3AFC); when bit 2 of +0xA8 is set it runs the updaters (kind-2 items of type 0x130001 with flag byte 0x14 set get Unit102857D0_InvokeCallback18).
0x10278490.summary: sqmdModelUpdate: runs a shown model's updaters.

0x10278710.name: SqmdModel_Link
0x10278710.evidence: Prints "model is not loaded, aborting ..." (0x103B3B14) with the string at 0x103B3B44 when bit 0 of +0xA8 is clear; the function refers to the DLL string "link". For every kind-3 item without flag 0x2000 whose name does not start with "eyelash" it calls fn_102787F0, and refers to "eyelash" a second time.
0x10278710.summary: Links each of a model's shapes into the scene through fn_102787F0, treating shapes named eyelash* separately.

0x102787F0.name: SqmdModel_LinkShape
0x102787F0.evidence: Same not-loaded check (sqmdModel.c line 0x2BF); grows the arrays at +0x9C/+0xA0 with SqMem_Realloc (fn_10275E90) (sqmdModel.c lines 0x2C8/0x2CA) when the count at +0xA4 reaches +0x5C, then looks up the shape's item, its kind-1 item and the "%s_sort" kind-2 item (SqmdModel_LookupKind2). Only caller SqmdModel_Link.
0x102787F0.summary: Links one shape of a model into the scene and records the entry in the model's arrays at +0x9C/+0xA0.

0x10278990.name: SqmdModel_AddIllumLight
0x10278990.evidence: Abort message names it: "aborting %s command" with "sqmdModelAddIllumLight" (0x103B3B54). For each entry at +0x9C (optionally only those whose item flag at +0x54 is non-negative) it calls fn_1028F2E0(scene, entry, param_3).
0x10278990.summary: sqmdModelAddIllumLight: adds a light to every scene entry of the model.

0x10278B50.name: SqmdModel_AddShadowLightInLayer
0x10278B50.evidence: Abort message names it: "sqmdModelAddShadowLightInLayer" (0x103B3BA4). For each entry at +0x9C whose high 16 bits equal param_3 (the layer), optionally only flagged ones, it calls fn_1028F350(scene, entry, param_4).
0x10278B50.summary: sqmdModelAddShadowLightInLayer: adds a shadow light to the model's scene entries in one layer.

0x10278BF0.name: SqmdModel_Show
0x10278BF0.evidence: Abort message with "sqmdModelShow" (string listed for this function); sets bytes +0x1C and +0x1D of every scene entry (SqsnScene_GetEntryAddr) to 0xFF and sets bit 2 of +0xA8.
0x10278BF0.summary: sqmdModelShow: marks the model's scene entries visible and sets its shown flag.

0x10278E10.name: SqmdModel_SetLayerSort
0x10278E10.evidence: Abort message with "sqmdModelSetLayerSort" (string listed for this function); param_2 -1 toggles, non-zero sets, 0 clears bit 0x8000 of +0xA8.
0x10278E10.summary: sqmdModelSetLayerSort: sets, clears or toggles the model's layer-sort flag (0x8000 at +0xA8).

0x10279710.name: SqmdModel_GetItem
0x10279710.evidence: Prints "negative array index %d" (0x103B3D54) for a negative index; switch on the kind param_2 returns entry param_3 of the table for that kind (kind 0: +0x1C/count +0x24, 1: +0x2C/+0x34, 2: +0x3C/+0x44, ...). Called by SqmdModel_GetItemKind0..4 with the kind as constant.
0x10279710.summary: Returns item param_3 of kind param_2 (texture, shader, updater, shape, ...) of a model, or 0 when out of range.

0x10279BF0.name: SqmdModel_FindItemByName
0x10279BF0.evidence: Scans the name table (+0x70 names, +0x74 kinds, +0x78 indices, count +0x7C) for an entry of kind param_3 whose name equals param_2 (sqScript_TokenEquals), stores its index in *param_4 and returns SqmdModel_GetItemKindN of it.
0x10279BF0.summary: Looks up a model item by kind and name, returning the item and storing its index.

0x1027A1C0.name: SqmdModel_ItemKindName
0x1027A1C0.evidence: Switch returning the DLL strings "texture" (0), "shader" (1), "updater" (2), "shape" (3), the string at 0x1038A350 (4), "matrix" (5), "undefined" otherwise.
0x1027A1C0.summary: Returns the name of an item kind for messages.
